name: lidia-admin
description: Ferramentas de análise de dados da LidIA: banco do aplicativo e bases da educação brasileira, com SQL somente leitura. Requer conta de administrador da LidIA.

interface.longDescription: Read-only analysis of LidIA application data in PostgreSQL and Brazilian education data in a fixed BigQuery dataset. A LidIA administrator account is required. Other accounts can connect, but tools deny unauthorized calls. Approved review accounts see isolated synthetic application tables. Authorized administrators can receive raw query rows; those rows are shared with the connected assistant. This plugin works independently.
defaultPrompt: How many non-deleted conversations exist in the sample database?
Show the application schema, then count users by municipality.

pt-BR.subtitle: Análise de dados para admins
pt-BR.description: Ferramentas de análise de dados da LidIA: banco do aplicativo e bases da educação brasileira, com SQL somente leitura. Requer conta de administrador da LidIA. Pessoas sem perfil de administrador conseguem conectar, mas cada ferramenta responde que é exclusiva para administradores. Contas de revisão autorizadas acessam somente tabelas sintéticas do aplicativo em um esquema isolado.

publication.release_notes: Adds a standalone README with setup, examples, and privacy information inside each plugin folder for directory review. Retains Jev SQL effect validation, native database enforcement, and synthetic reviewer isolation.

positive.prompt: Mostre o esquema completo do banco de demonstração da LidIA.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the isolated synthetic catalog with dataScope=review.

positive.prompt: Liste as tabelas do aplicativo e descreva users.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the synthetic users table columns only, with review provenance.

positive.prompt: Mostre 2 linhas de chat_sessions do banco de demonstração.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 2 synthetic rows and review provenance.

positive.prompt: Quantas conversas não excluídas existem no banco de demonstração?
positive.expected_behavior: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_sessions WHERE NOT is_deleted returns 2 in the prepared fixture.

positive.prompt: Liste as tabelas educacionais, descreva ideb_territorio e consulte uma amostra de 2023.
positive.expected_behavior: Return public education data from bases-cl-fl.painel_equidade with source and year filters.
